title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Approving the Reform of Centralized Adjudication of Administrative Cases by the High People's Court of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region
keywords_en: administrative litigation; High People's Court handling administrative cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Reply on Approving the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region High People's Court to Carry Out Reform of Centralized Jurisdiction over Administrative Cases

Fa [2019] No. 159

Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region High People's Court:

Your court's "Request for Instructions on Implementing the Pilot Work of Relative Centralized Jurisdiction over Administrative Cases across Administrative Regions by the Yinhai District People's Court of Beihai" (Gui Gao Fa Qing [2019] No. 9) and "Request for Instructions on Implementing the Pilot Work of Relative Centralized Jurisdiction over Administrative Cases across Administrative Regions by the Jiangzhou District People's Court of Chongzuo" (Gui Gao Fa Qing [2019] No. 19) have both been received. Upon study, and in accordance with the provisions of Article 18, Paragraph 2 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and the spirit of the "Guiding Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on the Centralized Jurisdiction of People's Courts over Administrative Cases across Administrative Regions" (Fa Fa [2015] No. 8), we approve in principle the requests in your letters.

Please advance the reform under the unified leadership and coordination of the local Party committee, in accordance with the spirit of the central institutional reform and the requirements of the local institutional reform. When refining and implementing the reform plan, the administrative adjudication functions of the basic people's courts in each locality shall be retained to maintain the integrity of the litigation system and to serve local law-based administration. The plaintiff's right to choose shall be fully respected; the plaintiff may choose either the court at the defendant's location or the central court to exercise jurisdiction. Local courts and centralized jurisdiction courts shall strengthen communication and coordination, balancing the separation of mediation and adjudication with their integration, and jointly carry out the coordination and resolution of administrative disputes. A mechanism for unifying adjudication standards shall be established to prevent inconsistency in adjudication standards for similar cases due to different courts of jurisdiction. Before the implementation of the Plan, it shall be announced to the public by means of a notice. Your court shall strengthen research and guidance, and please timely report any new situations and issues arising during implementation to the Supreme People's Court.
